  3. Palazzo Massimo alle Terme – an underrated museum with a vast collection of ancient Roman art and artifacts.
  4. Crypta Balbi – located in the remains of an ancient Roman theater showcasing layers of Rome's history.
  5. Museo Nazionale Etrusco di Villa Giulia – devoted to the Etruscan civilization that predates ancient Rome.
  6. Chiostro del Bramante – a former monastery turned exhibition center showcasing contemporary art and photography.
